factual_claims.source_evidence: Condensed Statement of Comprehensive Income: 'Profit/loss before tax 16,012 10,403'... 'Profit/loss for the period 13,056 7,621'.

factual_claims.claim: Results were partly reduced by a SEK 3,707 million goodwill impairment, primarily reflecting higher discount rates for Akelius cash-generating units.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 3.2: 'Goodwill impairment... SEK 3,707 million'... 'The WACC applied in the impairment test increased 110-150 bps for Akelius CGUs... primary driver... rise in levered betas.'

factual_claims.claim: Total comprehensive income fell to SEK 4,199 million from SEK 11,082 million because of negative currency translation differences of SEK 8,857 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Condensed Statement of Comprehensive Income: 'Total comprehensive income/loss 4,199 11,082'... 'Currency translation differences -8,857 3,461'.

factual_claims.claim: The privatisation programme remained a major business development.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Multiple sections detail privatisation programme as key strategic initiative.

factual_claims.claim: Sales totalled SEK 10,664 million, covering 2,466 residential units sold at a 28.9% premium to book value.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: 2025 in Brief section: 'Privatisation sales of SEK 10,664 million; 2,466 residential units sold at a 28.9% premium to book value'.

factual_claims.claim: Together with other portfolio sales, proceeds supported deleveraging.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: MD&A discusses use of privatisation proceeds for debt reduction and deleveraging.

factual_claims.claim: Year-end investment property fair value was SEK 324,429 million, down from SEK 335,422 million, mainly reflecting divestments and currency effects despite positive operating performance and valuation gains in several markets.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 3.1 shows fair value movement from 335,422m to 324,429m, with explanations about divestments and currency impacts.

factual_claims.claim: Financial risk indicators improved.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: MD&A and financial metrics show improved leverage ratios and interest coverage.

factual_claims.claim: Net interest-bearing liabilities declined to SEK 170,212 million from SEK 190,381 million, net LTV fell to 52.2% from 56.4%, and the interest coverage ratio improved to 2.0x from 1.9x.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Alternative Performance Measures table shows these exact figures.

factual_claims.claim: Interest expense was broadly stable at SEK 6,536 million, although the average interest rate increased to 3.43% from 3.01%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: MD&A: 'For the year, interest expenses were SEK 6,536 million (6,554)... average interest rate ended the year at 3.43% from 3.01% a year ago.'

factual_claims.claim: Heimstaden Bostad completed approximately SEK 59.5 billion of financing, while unutilised credit facilities reached SEK 23.449 billion.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: MD&A: 'For subsidiary Heimstaden Bostad, financing markets remained strong, with SEK 44,900 million of asset-backed financing... SEK 14,600 million of capital markets issuance'... 'Heimstaden’s subsidiary Heimstaden Bostad, ended the quarter with SEK 23,449 million of unutilised credit facilities.'

factual_claims.claim: The group generated SEK 2,742 million of operating cash flow and ended the year with SEK 4,179 million in cash.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Condensed Statement of Cash Flows: 'Net cash generated from operating activities 2,742'... 'Cash and cash equivalents 4,179'.

factual_claims.claim: The parent company reported a loss before tax of SEK 33 million, improved from SEK 273 million, and no dividends were proposed.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Parent Company Statement of Comprehensive Income: 'Profit/loss before tax -33 -273'... 'It is proposed that the funds... is to be carried forward. No dividend shall be paid'.

factual_claims.claim: Fitch affirmed Heimstaden’s B- rating but revised the outlook to negative, while an arbitration award in favour of Heimstaden confirmed no breach of the Heimstaden Bostad shareholders’ agreement.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: 2025 in Brief: 'In January 2025, Fitch ratings affirmed the ‘B-‘ and revised the Outlook to Negative'... 'In December 2025, an award in favour of Heimstaden was received... confirming that there was no breach in the Shareholders Agreement.'
